summary: A territory-conquest tactical RPG series spanning the PlayStation original, its Japan-only Grand Edition, and the modern sequel The Legend of Runersia.

entries.title: Brigandine: The Legend of Forsena

emulation.notes: Use high internal resolution and PGXP geometry correction; confirm language route before a full stream.

primary.why: Grand Edition is the most complete documented version of the original Brigandine, adding multiplayer support and other new features over The Legend of Forsena.
primary.how_to_play: Use a Japanese Grand Edition disc or legally dumped image in DuckStation for the main completeness route; use the North American Legend of Forsena release only if English accessibility matters more than added content.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster of the original game is documented; Grand Edition remains a PlayStation release.

entries.title: Brigandine: The Legend of Runersia

emulation.notes: Use native PC capture; check compatibility notes if display or controller issues arise.

primary.why: The PC release is the highest-fidelity route and includes the post-game Creative Mode described for the Windows port.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam release on Windows with current patches; use Switch or PS4 only if console capture is preferred.

entries.remaster_caveats: No separate remaster documented; this is the modern sequel's PC port.
